goal: Publish the reviewed revision reproducibly, with evidence and a recovery path.
acceptance: The selected registered repository is the publication destination.
A stale head causes no branch update; credentials never enter an artifact or log.
Release state names whether source, artifact, deployment and live smoke were actually checked.
prompt: Prepare a release packet for the exact reviewed revision. Verify relative assets and source/artifact digests; publish only through the granted capability and report each observed stage separately.
